# adamdroberts/agent-skills

A small collection of [Agent Skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) shipped through multiple agent runtimes from one canonical source. Each skill lives in its own root folder with `SKILL.md` as the source of truth; per-agent adapters point back at it.

Marketplace name (Claude Code): `adamdroberts-skills`. Install: `/plugin marketplace add adamdroberts/agent-skills`.

## Skills

- [deep-documentation/SKILL.md](deep-documentation/SKILL.md) — produce and maintain serious repository documentation: README, browsable docs, API/reference pages, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, changelog, and repo-local agent skills. Use for documentation refreshes, LLM-friendly docs, or doc sync after code changes.
- [truthful-coder/SKILL.md](truthful-coder/SKILL.md) — strict change transparency: announce intent before edits, track actual changes, disclose every delta including incidental edits and tool-modified files. Use when editing code, notebooks, configs, or running commands.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md) — project overview, skill catalog, install snippets.
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) — documentation index.
- [docs/install.md](docs/install.md) — install paths for Claude Code (marketplace and project skills), Codex, Gemini CLI, and direct clone.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) — repo layout, canonical-folder + adapter pattern, Mermaid diagram of the four distribution paths.
- [docs/contributing.md](docs/contributing.md) — step-by-step guide to adding a new skill across all distribution channels.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — append-only history.

## Manifests and adapters

- [.claude-plugin/marketplace.json](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json) — Claude Code marketplace catalog.
- [deep-documentation/.claude-plugin/plugin.json](deep-documentation/.claude-plugin/plugin.json), [truthful-coder/.claude-plugin/plugin.json](truthful-coder/.claude-plugin/plugin.json) — per-plugin manifests.
- [.claude/skills/](.claude/skills/), [.agents/skills/](.agents/skills/) — symlink adapters for Claude Code project skills and Codex.
- [.gemini/agents/](.gemini/agents/) — markdown wrapper adapters for Gemini CLI.
- [.claude/README.md](.claude/README.md) — Claude Code-specific notes.
- [.codex/config.example.toml](.codex/config.example.toml), [.gemini/settings.example.json](.gemini/settings.example.json) — example per-agent configs.

## Full bundle

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — single-file bundle of canonical docs and skill content for ingestion.
